meta.title: MCP & Skills Studio
meta.description: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar; embeds the plugin market when dshmarket is installed.

en.deleteWarn: Removes the whole user skill directory. This cannot be undone.
en.formatPaste: Paste a JSON config (wrapper or bare entry)
en.importIntro: Scan Claude Code and Codex MCP configs and import selected entries.
en.importRepositoryHint: Enter a GitHub URL or owner/repo.
en.importRepositoryInvalid: Enter a valid GitHub URL or owner/repo.
en.mcpIntro: Manage MCP server rows in this profile. Changes apply after a dsh restart.
en.pasteTransportMismatch: The row transport is locked and differs from the pasted config.
en.removeWarn: Removes this profile row; tools disappear after restart.
en.restartConfirmBody: Restarting interrupts running turns and may lose unsaved input.
en.restarting: Restarting; the page reloads when the host returns…
en.restartNeeded: Configuration written; restart dsh to apply.
en.restartOtherHint: Close this dsh process and run it again.
en.restartPortHint: If recovery takes too long, the port may have changed.
en.saved: Saved; it will become available shortly.
en.shadowedByGlobal: a global row with the same id wins — this row has no effect
en.skillDisabledMsg: Disabled for both model and slash commands.
en.skillEnabled: Enabled; the list reflects it shortly.
en.skillsIntro: View and manage discovered skills, including user and repository skills. Each card switch controls loading.
en.toggleSkillHint: Disable model and user invocation; enabling restores defaults.
en.workspaceUnavailable: No workspace is available. Open or connect a workspace before creating a skill.
